payload.content: Before writing the SELECT, identify the row(s) of the relevant table that the question filters to. State the literal value(s) of the filter column(s) for those row(s) (e.g., 'state = California', 'year = 2020'), then write the SELECT using those exact filter values.

Place all auxiliary thinking, including filter values consulted and reasoning steps, in the `cells_consulted` field. The `sql_query` field must contain only the final SQL with no preamble, narration, or self-commentary.

payload.name: cells_consulted
payload.description: Filter values from the table the SQL targets, listed before the SQL is written.

rationale: Adapter of wtq's rt_filter_rows_then_extract mechanism (proven +0.371 on wtq×arithmetic-yes) to bird SQL — forces row-value grounding before SELECT, with aux field to avoid sql_query pollution.
